board: Adafruit MSA301 Triple Axis Accelerometer breakout, STEMMA QT / Qwiic (#4344)
reason: Check passed on esp32 and pico (spec, wiring, design checks, breadboard, simulator test, circuit board). Modelled from the MSA301 datasheet (addr 0x26, PARTID 0x13, 14-bit left-justified little-endian axes, 4096 LSB/g at ±2 g, suspend at power-up) with the header order VIN/3Vo/GND/SCL/SDA/INT and 10 kΩ pull-ups to VIN taken from Adafruit's board photo and Eagle schematic.
breakoutPinoutSource: https://learn.adafruit.com/msa301-triple-axis-accelerometer/pinouts (board photo silkscreen VIN 3Vo GND SCL SDA INT) and https://github.com/adafruit/Adafruit-MSA301-PCB schematic JP1 pins 1-6
